title: website_sale — wishlist/loyalty/gift_card cross-module chain (GAP-026 depth)
gap_note: GAP-026 depth extended: wishlist, loyalty, gift card (via loyalty program_type), and delivery integration chains fully mapped; no standalone website_gift_card module exists in Community — gift cards handled via sale_loyalty with program_type=gift_card in website_sale_loyalty

l1_l12_summary.L2: C1 — Key model fields: website_id/cart_quantity/website_order_line on sale.order; product.wishlist with session/partner dual mode; ecommerce_ok/disabled_auto_rewards on loyalty models
l1_l12_summary.L3: C1 — Cart lifecycle (session→abandoned cart→payment lock); wishlist (session→login merge); coupon (pending_coupon_code session→_try_pending_coupon→_try_apply_code→_apply_program_reward→auto_apply_rewards)

l1_l12_summary.L5: C1 — 10+ routes in website_sale; 4 in wishlist; 3+ in loyalty; views files confirmed in manifests
l1_l12_summary.L6: C1 — product_template_public rule; wishlist own-record rule; ecommerce_access gate; sudo escalation pattern; nominative program block for public users
l1_l12_summary.L7: C2 — ecommerce_ok per program; website_id per program; ecommerce_access; cart_abandoned_delay; account_on_checkout; ICP website_sale_coupon.abandonned_coupon_validity

key_finding: website_sale_loyalty replaces the standard sale_ok program domain with ecommerce_ok when an order has a website_id, adds website isolation, and introduces a pre-payment guard that recalculates rewards and blocks transactions where the total changed — creating a tightly coupled delivery↔loyalty↔payment validation chain absent from plain sales orders
